Mr. Spengler is also the founder of Blueprint Schools Network, where he has led the organization’s strategy and operations. Previously, he served as Program Director of The Education Innovation Laboratory at Harvard University (EdLabs), overseeing the implementation of education research and field experiments in school districts across the country. He has also served as Chief Academic Officer for Lighthouse Academies and National Director of New School Development for the Big Picture Company.
